messages.content: How do I apply for leave on the PeoplePulse portal?

To apply for leave at **DSP Asset Management Company**, follow the verified workflow below:

1. **Log in to PeoplePulse**: Open the DSP PeoplePulse HRMS portal ([peoplepulse.dspamc.com](https://peoplepulse.dspamc.com)) with your corporate SSO.
2. **Navigate**: Go to **My Workspace > Leave Management > Apply Leave**.
3. **Select Leave Type & Dates**: Choose between **Earned Leave (EL)**, **Casual/Sick Leave (CL/SL)**, or Compensatory Off.
4. **Handover Protocol**: Nominate a peer delegate for your operational portfolio responsibilities.
5. **Notice Period**: For absences exceeding 3 consecutive business days, submit at least **7 working days in advance**.
6. **Approval SLA**: Your reporting manager has a **48-hour SLA** to action your request. Unattended requests escalate to the Department Head after 72 hours.

citations.snippet:
1. Access the DSP PeoplePulse HRMS portal (https://peoplepulse.dspamc.com/leave) using your Single Sign-On (SSO) credentials.
2. Navigate to 'My Workspace' > 'Leave Management' > 'Apply Leave'.
3. Select the leave category (Earned Leave, Casual Leave, Sick Leave, or Compensatory Off), enter the start/end dates, and state the handover delegate.
4. For leaves exceeding 3 consecutive business days, submission must be completed at least 7 working days in advance.
5. Your Reporting Manager has a 48-hour SLA to approve or reject the request. Automatic escalation to the Department Head occurs if unaddressed after 72 hours.

messages.content: How do I request IT access?

To request IT, application, or network access at DSPAMC:

1. **Access ServiceHub**: Open [https://servicehub.dspamc.com/access-request](https://servicehub.dspamc.com) via your browser.
2. **Catalog Selection**: Click **Service Catalog > Identity & Access Management > Application Access Request**.
3. **Choose Target System**: Select Bloomberg Terminal, Refinitiv Eikon, PostgreSQL Analytical DB, Qdrant Vector Store, or internal Git.
4. **Business Justification**: Specify your project or mandate with required permissions (e.g. Read-Only vs Admin).
5. **Approval Flow**: Your direct Reporting Manager approves first, followed by InfoSec validation. Provisioning completes within **24 hours**.
6. **Remote Access / VPN**: Remote workers require Cisco AnyConnect/GlobalProtect with Microsoft Authenticator 2FA.

citations.snippet:
To request access to internal applications, databases, or specialized market software:
1. Log into the DSP ServiceHub Portal (https://servicehub.dspamc.com/access-request).
2. Select 'Service Catalog' > 'Identity & Access Management' > 'Application Access Request'.
3. Choose the target system: Bloomberg Terminal, Refinitiv Eikon, Qdrant Vector Store, PostgreSQL Analytical DB, or Internal Git Repositories.
4. Specify your business rationale and required privilege level (Read-Only vs Read-Write).
5. Workflow: Direct Line Manager approves -> InfoSec compliance validation -> System auto-provisions within 24 hours.

Remote connectivity into DSPAMC internal networks requires Cisco AnyConnect / GlobalProtect VPN paired with Microsoft Authenticator push notification. Hardware security keys (YubiKey) are mandated for all Dealers and Portfolio Managers handling live trade execution. Passwords must meet enterprise complexity standards (minimum 14 characters, alpha-numeric with symbols) and expire every 90 days.

messages.content:
### DSPAMC Leave Entitlements Summary (FY2026-27)

• **Earned Leave (EL)**: 18 days credited quarterly (4.5 days per quarter). Carry-forward is capped at a maximum of **45 days**.
• **Casual / Sick Leave (CL/SL)**: 12 days credited annually on April 1st.
• **Maternity Leave**: 26 weeks paid leave per the Maternity Benefit Act.
• **Paternity Leave**: 10 working days paid leave (taken within 6 months of childbirth).
• **Bereavement Leave**: 5 working days paid leave.

citations.snippet: Employees are credited with 18 days of Earned Annual Leave (EL) per financial year, accrued on a quarterly basis (4.5 days per quarter). In addition, all full-time employees receive 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave (CL/SL) annually credited on April 1st. Unutilized EL may be carried forward up to a maximum cap of 45 days. Any EL accumulated beyond 45 days is subject to mandatory encashment or forfeiture as per AMFI/DSPAMC governance standards.

citations.snippet: Female employees are entitled to 26 weeks of paid Maternity Leave in accordance with the Maternity Benefit Act. Male employees receive 10 working days of paid Paternity Leave, which may be taken continuously or in two tranches within 6 months following childbirth. DSPAMC also provides 5 working days of paid Bereavement Leave and 12 weeks of Adoption Leave.
